identificationModule.briefTitle: SHR-A1811 Combined with Apatinib in the Treatment of Advanced Gastric or Gastroesophageal Junction Adenocarcinoma and Colorectal Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: Exploratory Clinical Study of SHR-A1811 Combined with Apatinib in the Treatment of Advanced Gastric or Gastroesophageal Junction Adenocarcinoma and Colorectal Cancer

descriptionModule.briefSummary: To evaluate the effectiveness and safety of SHR-A1811 combined with apatinib in the treatment of advanced gastric or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma and colorectal cancer.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription:
This is a prospective, dual arm, exploratory clinical research. To evaluate the effectiveness and safety of SHR-A1811 combined with apatinib in the treatment of advanced gastric or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma and colorectal cancer.

Cohort A will enroll subjects with advanced gastric or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma, while Cohort B will enroll subjects with advanced colorectal cancer.

The primary endpoint is objective remission rate (ORR). Secondary endpoints include disease control rate (DCR), duration of remission (DoR), progression-free survival (PFS), overall survival (OS) and safety.
